2609.31282.title: Resource-Optimized and Energy-Aware Agentic AI Framework Anchored on Blockchain for Secure Software Supply Chains
2609.31282.paper_summary: This paper proposes a blockchain-backed agentic security framework designed to safeguard the complete software development lifecycle (SDLC) while also securing the agentic AI components responsible for monitoring it. The framework coordinates a set of specialised security agents, covering source integrity, dependency and SBOM analysis, CI configura tion auditing, artifact verification, and runtime policy evaluation, each supported by a large language model (LLM) that interprets artefacts, reasons over tool outputs, and produces structured security reports. To ensure agent trustworthiness, every agent generates a cryptographically signed attestation that is recorded in a permissioned blockchain via smart contracts, including an agent registry, an immutable attestation log, and an enforceable release-policy module. Communication among agents and with blockchain nodes is secured using a consortium-operated certificate authority, ensuring authenticated and tamper-resistant interactions. A detailed use-case and sequence flow demonstrate how a source code security agent performs analysis, anchors its attestation on-chain, and triggers a verifiable allow/block deployment decision. The proposed framework of fers decentralised integrity transparent provenance, uninterrupted security assurance and a generalisable architecture to incorporate the agentic AI into the modern software supply chain security.
2609.31282.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文提出了一個基於區塊鏈的代理安全框架，旨在保護完整的軟體開發生命周期（SDLC），同時保障負責監控的代理人工智慧組件的安全。該框架協調一組專門的安全代理，涵蓋源碼完整性、依賴性和SBOM分析、CI配置審計、工件驗證以及運行時政策評估，每個代理都由一個大型語言模型（LLM）支持，該模型解釋工件、推理工具輸出並生成結構化的安全報告。為了確保代理的可信性，每個代理生成一個加密簽名的證明，該證明通過智能合約記錄在一個授權區塊鏈中，包括代理註冊、不可變的證明日誌和可執行的發布政策模塊。代理之間以及與區塊鏈節點之間的通信使用由聯盟運營的證書授權機構進行安全保護，確保身份驗證和防篡改的互動。一個詳細的用例和序列流程展示了源碼安全代理如何執行分析、將其證明錨定在鏈上，並觸發可驗證的允許/阻止部署決策。所提出的框架提供去中心化的完整性透明來源、不間斷的安全保證以及一個可通用的架構，以將代理人工智慧納入現代軟體供應鏈安全中。
